The '''Damoria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions. It was connected via the [[Quellor Run/Legends|Quellor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor]] and [[Chorax system/Legends|Chorax systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Damoria [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian Manufacturing Corporation]].<ref name="CSWECite">{{CSWECite|I|163|Damorian Manufacturing Corporation}}</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it was the site of a civilian-operated Class IB [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] whose output was limited to [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Damoria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-11.<ref name="TEA" />
